Annual GDS Alumni Challenge 2 Mile Run/Walk
Description:
An opportunity for GDS running alumni to return and run again with former coaches, teachers, and current members of the GDS running teams.  Runners and walkers of all ages are encouraged to come out to participate in this low-key, free race along a flat course beside the beautiful C & O Canal. No registration necessary.

The race begins and ends in the Fletcher's Cove Boathouse parking lot (4940 Canal Rd NW, Washington, DC 20007 - Corner of Canal Road & Reservoir Road).
Email: abelber@gds.org

Title: 10th, 11th & 12th Grade New Student Orientation
Description:
All new-to-GDS 10th, 11th and 12th graders will gather for a chance to meet each other, learn about the culture of the high school, connect with some current students, meet with staff (teachers, deans, administrators), and get familiar with the building before the first day of school.

Questions? hsoffice@gds.org

Title: General Information Session about Transportation Options Session #2
Description:
Do you have questions about our commute to GDS for Fall, 2025? Join one of our upcoming information sessions. During these sessions, we will talk through the various options and restrictions related to commuting to GDS and answer questions that you might have. We will also be able to help you determine what commuting method is best for your family.  

If you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to ImproveMyCommute@gds.org.

Title: 9th Grade Bridge Program
Description:
Hop-Into-GDS Bridge Program. We invite new-to-GDS 9th graders to join us for our Hop-Into-GDS Program, intended to give students new to GDS a preview of life within the High School community. The goals of this program are to expose and introduce students to the GDS High School experience and to develop a cohort of students who are able to grow together as a community before 9th grade orientation begins.

Email hs-office@gds.org with questions.
